title: 3-D: fields in a plane through the axis and the mid-plane profiles
caption: The 3-D case at g = 40 dx: a rotor of radius 3 g and length 3 g turning at Omega about z in a coaxial housing of radius 4 g with end gaps g, micropolar fluid with K = 3, l = 10 dx, w = 0 on every wall, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu), h = 4 dx; run `g40_k3_m2_k2` (15,604,476 particles, 2 slabs, thesis-ch5-rc2-33-g13e69a3). (a) to (d): the fluid particles within 1.5 dx of the plane y = 0 at the last step: (a) azimuthal velocity, (b) axial and (c) radial component of the micro-rotation (radial: along x, with the sign of x), (d) magnitude of w - curl v / 2 (curl by weighted least squares over the neighbours within 3 dx): the wall layers on every face of the rotor and of the housing; dashed line: the cut between the two slabs (5090 on the left, XTX on the right). (e), (f): bin means in the mid-plane (|z| < 2 dx, last quarter of the run) against the exact solution between infinite cylinders of the same radii. Mid-plane constant of v_theta over the 2-D one: 0.9990; rms deviation of the mid-plane profiles from the 2-D ones 5.9e-03 (v) and 6.5e-03 (w); the fitted constant of v_theta(r) is within 1 % of its mid-plane value further than 0.46 g from the rotor's ends and within 0.1 % further than 1.36 g. Change against the Newtonian control `g40_newtonian_k2`: mid-plane 0.1682 (2-D exact 0.1669), torque 0.1924 by the wall form (lateral surface 0.1863, end faces 0.2069) and 0.1855 by the flux across the surface at distance h. On the housing the torque changes by 0.1970; with the advective term the flux form gives 0.1848. Table 15b sets this run beside the one at g = 20 dx. Its rows 'the wall rule' are the Newtonian fluid of viscosity mu_inf in the slip-form geometry of the rule (lateral surface of the rotor at R1 + delta turning at Omega (R1 - delta) / (R1 + delta), its end faces moved out by delta and turning at Omega, every face of the housing moved in by delta, delta = 3.75 dx; at the rim each wall particle of the rotor takes the rate of the surface it is nearer to) over the same control: mid-plane 0.1724, torque 0.2429 (flux form), 0.2429 (housing), 0.2410 (wall form). Decay length of the wall layer on the rotor's end face: 0.99 l for the tangential component and 0.98 of l sqrt(nu_inf / nu) for the normal one.
